answer: Picture an agent harbor where every identity must moor at a public wharf to trade: each berth is a scarce, staked slot, and a newcomer starts at the outer anchorage with no berth at all. Harbor-masters keep independent arrival manifests, and a whisper network cross-checks each docking claim against behavioral fingerprints — cargo patterns, timing, counterparties. A Sybil fleet betrays itself when many manifests share one fingerprint under different names, so the wharf revokes all its berths and burns the stake. Gossip spreads revocation faster than new identities can be minted.
